diagnostic_commands: cg=/sys/fs/cgroup/system.slice/httpd.service/cpu.stat; a=$(awk '/usage_usec/{print $2}' "$cg" 2>/dev/null); read -r _ u n s i w q r t _ < /proc/stat; total1=$((u+n+s+i+w+q+r+t)); idle1=$((i+w)); sleep 2; b=$(awk '/usage_usec/{print $2}' "$cg" 2>/dev/null); read -r _ u n s i w q r t _ < /proc/stat; total2=$((u+n+s+i+w+q+r+t)); idle2=$((i+w))
awk -v a="$a" -v b="$b" -v cores="$(nproc)" 'BEGIN{if(a!="" && b!="")printf "apache_cpu=%.1f\n",(b-a)/2000000/cores*100;else print "apache_cpu=unknown"}'
echo '=== APACHE LOG ==='; journalctl -u httpd -n 12 --no-pager; echo '=== SYSTEM ERRORS ==='; journalctl -p err -n 8 --no-pager; true
